title: claude-settings mods update themselves after the first install
why: Your question, Oct 26: why did your claude-settings install never pick up the token-weather 500k fix? Mods were fetched once, on Oct 13, and never refreshed.
note: Ruling, Oct 26 (shiv, "agreeed"): mods stay current by marketplace auto-update alone, with no installer step. Cause, checked at main 3f71d6b: the claude-settings marketplace entry in settings.json had no "autoUpdate": true, and Claude Code leaves third-party marketplaces un-refreshed by default; install.sh and install.ps1 never touch plugins, by design (decision mods-install-via-marketplace). So each mod stayed at its first-install version (desktop-statusline 0.1.3 on the Mac against main's 0.1.5). Fix: PR #581 (mods auto-update from the claude-settings marketplace), reviewed with no findings; CI running; shiv merges on the Mac. One-off catch-up given to shiv: `claude plugin marketplace update claude-settings`, then `claude plugin update <mod>@claude-settings` per mod. Proof after merge, on the Mac: after the first session, `claude plugin list` shows each claude-settings mod at main's version. Ahead of c52 (triage, Oct 26): it waits only on a merge path (c53), and it carries #580 (c29) to the Mac.
